content:
The execution failed because the summary output used 'Final decision:' instead of the required 'Decision:' keyword.
The test_summary_contains_key_outputs in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with an AssertionError. While the summary correctly calculated revenue metrics and a 'keep_90_day' result, it produced the string 'Final decision: keep_90_day' which did not satisfy the 'Decision:' substring requirement. Six other tests passed, confirming the data loading and line count constraints (4-8 lines) were met.
